title: Workstream B: Monte Carlo Resolution & Sensitivity Audit
resolution_limitation_statement: With B = 2,500 repetitions, the minimum achievable non-zero p-value is 1 / 2501 ≈ 0.00039984. All 12 rejected hypotheses had zero exceedances in 2,500 draws and were bounded at p = 1/2501, resulting in an identical Holm adjusted p-value of 0.035186. This boundary p-value reflects the finite resolution ceiling of B = 2,500, not a precise estimate of true probability.
